facts.title: Whole Wheat Gingerbread Pancakes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsulphured molasses (the strength of your molasses will determine the intensity of the gingerbread flavor—lighter molasses imparts less flavor, whereas blackstrap can be pretty intense)
2 tablespoons maple syrup or coconut sugar or brown sugar
2 tablespoons melted butter or coconut oil
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
